events.title: Adult 55+ Autry Museum Day Trip
events.location: Los Angeles, CA
events.description:
The Autry Museum of the American West brings together the stories of all peoples of the American West, connecting the past with the present to inspire our shared future.  

Located in beautiful Griffith Park, the Autry Museum of the American West features unique galleries showcasing paintings, sculptures, film memorabilia, photographs, historic firearms, and much more—all exploring the history, art, and culture of the American West. With more than 600,000 works of art and cultural objects, the Autry is also home to one of the largest and most significant collections of Native American materials in the United States.

The Autry presents a wide range of art, history, and culture exhibitions, events, and public programs including lectures, films, theater performances, festivals, and family activities. 

Permanent exhibits include: Art of the West, Cowboy Gallery, California Continued Ethnobotanical Garden, Human Nature, Waterways, Rowen Textile Gallery, California Road Trip, The Balance of Power on the 
American Frontier, The Colt Revolver in the American West, Journeys Gallery, and Western Frontiers:  
Stories of Fact and Fiction.

This Day Trip has a "Walk Grade" of MODERATE (3 out of 5)

events.title: Library: Designing Worlds with The National Animation Museum
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
Visually driven, 45-minute hosted conversation explores how artists and filmmakers transform initial ideas and sketches into believable animated and cinematic worlds.

The program then goes beyond the screen to examine how major film and animation franchises are translated into exhibitions and immersive experiences that audiences can physically enter. The conversation will also consider how these same storytelling and design principles can help shape the National Animation Museum's future exhibitions and visitor experiences.

Moderated by National Animation Museum Director Christine Farris, the conversation features animation art director and production designer Mehrdad Isvandi, and National Animation Museum Creative Director Robin Stapley. Their discussion will be illustrated with concept artwork, film imagery, behind-the-scenes stories, and examples drawn from their careers.

events.title: Library: Managing Devices Without The Fight
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
A hybrid event you can attend in-person or at home! Join us as we learn how families can build healthy habits around smart devices and video games, without the fights!

Tired of the daily battles over screen time? Join Jim Festante, Executive Director of Health-e-Habits and a 20-year media industry insider, for a practical workshop designed to bring peace back to your living room. We will look under the hood of popular games and apps to understand the fundamental difference between a digital "Sandbox" (where kids create and control the play) and a digital "Casino" (where algorithms extract their attention). Walk away with actionable, stress-free strategies to establish healthy boundaries, reduce tech-related meltdowns, and help your family build mindful digital habits without the fight.

events.location:

1100 W Clark Ave
Burbank, CA 91506
events.description:
About the Burbank Art Association
Founded in 1950, the Burbank Art Association (BAA) is a nonprofit, volunteer-driven organization dedicated to fostering creativity and supporting the visual arts in our community. We welcome artists of all skill levels—as well as anyone with a passion for cultural arts—to join our vibrant membership.

Through regular meetings, exhibitions, and community events, BAA provides opportunities to share artwork, exchange ideas, and celebrate artistic expression. Members enjoy supportive fellowship, creative inspiration, and educational demonstrations in a wide variety of media.

events.title: Library: The Dark Frontier
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
A conversation between author Jeffrey Marlow and Kevin Hand, director of JPL's Ocean Worlds Lab, on the hidden world of the deep sea, whose secrets can revise our understanding of life itself.

Marine microbiologist and explorer Jeffrey Marlow takes readers on a fascinating journey into the deep sea in The Dark Frontier, exploring one of Earth’s last largely unexplored frontiers. Marlow reveals the remarkable life and ecosystems found in extreme environments, from hydrothermal vents and methane seeps to whale falls, while examining theories about the deep sea’s role in the origins of life. He also explores the growing tensions between ocean exploration and exploitation, including deep-sea mining and the challenges of protecting the high seas. Through stories from scientists, conservationists, and other experts, Marlow offers an accessible look at the wonders of the deep sea and what they can teach us about our planet’s future.

Copies of The Dark Frontier and Alien Oceans will be available at this event, and the authors will be available to sign.

events.title: Burbank Water and Power Board Meeting
events.description:
BWP's Board meetings are typically held on the first Thursday of each month at 5:00 p.m. at the BWP Administration Building, third floor Boardroom, 164 W. Magnolia Blvd., Burbank, California. 

This facility is disabled accessible. Auxiliary aids and services are available for individuals with speech, hearing or visual impairments (48 hours notice is required). Please contact BWP at (818) 238-3550 to make arrangements. 

Full agenda packets and meeting minutes are available on the Burbank City website at Burbankca.gov.

events.title: Civil Service Board
events.location: City Hall Council Chambers
events.description: The powers and duties of the Board shall be: To hold hearings regarding rules to supplement this article and subsequent revisions and amendments thereto and to recommend to the City Manager for submission to the Council such rules as are herein provided for; To act in an advisory capacity to the City Manager and City Council on problems concerning personnel administration; As provided by this article and by any rules, adopted to supplement this article, to hear appeals submitted by any employee hereunder, relative to any situation connected with his employment status or condition of employment; and, In any hearing conducted by the Board, it shall have the power to examine witnesses under oath and compel their attendance and/or the production of evidence before it by subpoenas issued in the manner and subject to the penalties provided by law. Each member of the Board shall have the power to administer oaths to witnesses.

events.title: Burbank Athletic Federation Board Meeting
events.location:
Community Services Building, Room 101
150 N. Third St.
events.description:
Since 1947, The Burbank Athletic Federation (BAF) has assisted the Parks and Recreation Department with fostering, promoting, and developing amateur athletics in the City of Burbank.

The goals of the BAF include building good sportsmanship and character, citizen training, and physical maintenance for all participants as well as encourage friendly rivalry, group spirit, and team play. Meetings are held the first Tuesday of each month.
